_readme: app.* functions granted to `authenticated` that are NOT in tests/rls-matrix.ts, each with the reason (at least 10 characters). check:rpc-registry fails on a granted function listed in neither place, and on an entry here that is no longer granted.

allowlist.current_venue: Read-only helper: returns the caller's own venue id. Granted because column defaults and RLS policies run as the calling role.
allowlist.staff_role: Read-only helper: returns the caller's own role or NULL. Granted because RLS policies run as the calling role.
allowlist.is_staff: Read-only helper: whether the caller holds one of the given roles. Granted because RLS policies run as the calling role.
